resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Functions[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

[b]Functions[/b] are an important part of Go.

They allow you to define a block of code, give it a name and call it in the code. This makes the function code reusable, as you can call it multiple times in different parts of your program.

We have already seen some functions in our previous examples. 
For example, the [b]Println[/b]() function outputs text:[code format="go" codeId="3320"]fmt.Println("Hello") [/code]
[b]Println[/b] is the name of the function, while "Hello" is the [b]argument[/b] which we provide to the function using the parentheses.
 
Remember, to call a function, we always use the [b]name[/b] of the function followed by [b]parentheses[/b].
[note]We will learn more about [b]arguments[/b] in the upcoming lessons.[/note]

resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Functions[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

In addition to the functions available in Go packages, you can define your own functions!

Use the [b]func[/b] keyword to define your own custom function.

[s0l0!-header][b]For example:[/b][/s0l0!-header][code format="go" ]func welcome() {
  fmt.Println("Hello")
} [/code]
We defined a function named "welcome", which outputs "Hello" to the screen.
Note that the code block of the function needs to be enclosed in curly braces.

Now we can call our function in [b]main[/b]:[code format="go" codeId="3321"]func main() {
  welcome()
  welcome()
} [/code]
Use the name of our function, followed by parentheses.
[note]As you can see from the example above, we can call our function multiple times. [/note]

resolved.problem_statement_md:
示例代码中调用了函数**talk**()，该函数应输出文本 "GO"。
在**main**()中调用了3次`talk()`，但缺少函数定义部分。

请添加代码来定义**talk**()函数，函数中输出"GO"。
resolved.problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Go![/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

You are given code that includes calls to a function called "[b]talk()[/b]", which should output the text "[b]GO[/b]".
The function is called 3 times in [b]main[/b](), but the code is missing the function declaration.

Add the missing code to declare the [b]talk[/b]() function, which should output "[b]GO[/b]" to the screen.
[note]Note, that the output should be in all caps.[/note]

code_templates.template:
package main
import "fmt"

func main() {
    talk()
    talk()
    talk()
}
